bullets.text: Led development of AI-powered financial intelligence over 7 years of FOMC history using Python pipelines, multi-agent reasoning and retrieval to cut macro analysis from 3 days to under 20 minutes.

Visualized MRIs, prior studies, and AI segmentations for a 20-person research team in a React and TypeScript clinician dashboard with interactive mask refinement.

Overhauled Oracle CRM into an in-house operations platform on React and MongoDB serving onboarding timesheets and reviews for 3,000 employees in production.
Organized hierarchical org views on React and MongoDB letting managers approve reviews and timesheets across 10 direct reports in production.
Implemented FastAPI and PostgreSQL services powering application tracking, search APIs, and production data synchronization across the platform.
Maintained 99.9% uptime across 2K+ daily production queries by running the platform on Cloudflare Pages and Workers with Docker.
Produced a Spring Boot v1 REST query API with HATEOAS and OpenAPI for production insurance policy search over Elasticsearch-backed documents.
Compiled insurance events into a 3-node Elasticsearch cluster with a Kafka consumer service for low-latency policy search and retrieval.
